description: Pilot 4 fold map actually used (family -> fold). Recovered 2026-10-29 from the saved fold pickles: for each of the 141 eligible targets exactly one of the six pickles reproduces the saved prior_hgb k=0 Spearman (|diff|<1e-9) and it has the lowest in-sample fit of the six; each family maps to one pickle; training counts (n_train_targets, n_exact, n_cens) recomputed under this map equal the pickles for all six folds. Original p4common.folds used value_counts().sort_values(ascending=False) with an unstable tie order (platform dependent).
